ReleaseCdsDiskNew.volumeId: The ID of the disk to be released
ReleaseCdsDiskNew.autoSnapshot: When set to "on", the automatic snapshots associated with the disk will be deleted
ReleaseCdsDiskNew.manualSnapshot: When set to "on", the manual snapshots associated with the disk will be deleted
ReleaseCdsDiskNew.recycle: When set to "on", the data disk is moved to the recycle bin; when set to "off", it is deleted immediately. Defaults to "on".
ReleaseCdsDiskNew.cdsAttributeActive: Whether automatic snapshots are released according to the "release automatic snapshot with disk" attribute. Defaults to false; when set to true, release follows the automatic snapshot's associated release attribute, which takes priority over autoSnapshot
